page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a note in the right margin at the foot of the column (the marginal "nec" / "abfq;" beside the last line is a catchword-like insertion, treated as a note on the right). Running head at top with page number 117 at upper right.

main_text.l: propter datur etiam caufa formalis.Porrò
ex his duæ intrinsecæ sunt, materia, &
forma; duæ aliæ manent extrinsecæ, fi-
nalis, & efficiens. At
Obijcies 1 contra caufæ definitionē
sic. Allata definitio non conuenit caufæ
finali, ergo mala. Probatur antecedens.
Caufa finalis non influit in effectum ve-
re, ac realiter: non enim finis, quo agens
mouetur ad agendum, imprimit motum:
quis enim dicat pomi dulcoré v. g. trahe-
re physicè, ac mouere puerum, vt illud
amet? Est ergo finis pura cōditio,qua po-
sita, voluntas per se mouetur, ergo caufa
finalis vera caufa non est.
Resp. negando antecedens. Ad proba-
tionem distinguo:caufa finalis non influit
efficienter,concedo; non influit finaliter,
nego,alioquin si primo influeret modo,
non esset amplius finalis, sed efficiens.
Ergo finis est pura conditio, negatur, vt
suo loco dicemus,cùm de caufa finali.
Obijcies 2. Pater Æternus non est cau-
sa Filij,& nihilominus hic pendet à Patre,
igitur malè dicitur caufa id, à quo aliquid
pendet; vel sic. Filius Æternus pendet à
Patre, igitur iste est causa Filij;quod si di-
catur,absurdum erit. Probatur vtrumque
antecedens, nam reuera Filius procedit,
atq; accipit esse à Patre, nec sine illo esse
potest, ergo pendet.
Resp.negando antecedens, non enim
sufficit ad rigorosam dependentiam,quòd
filius nequeat esse absq; Patre, alioquin
Pater etiā penderet à Filio, quia nec illo absq;

page.notes: The note "nec illo / absq;" in the right margin at the foot is printed beside the last line and is transcribed in the text as it appears. Some marginal glyphs are faint; the layout is a single text column.
